prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A four-asset illustration sheet for Android FitnessApp, exercise Puente de glúteos (glutes_bridge). EXACT FOUR EQUAL PANELS, STRICT 2x2 grid with perfectly centered vertical and horizontal division. No borders, no margins, NO TEXT NO LABELS NO NUMBERS NO LOGOS. Upper-left movement initial position; upper-right middle of movement; lower-left final contraction/end range; lower-right muscle map. The first three panels show same realistic adult athlete, same modest charcoal sleeveless gym top and shorts, same camera angle and same equipment; three clearly DIFFERENT poses to explain the motion. Choose three-quarter SIDE view that makes the movement and joint angles unmistakable. All relevant limbs and equipment fully inside each panel, normal five-finger hands, plausible equipment and joints. Dark studio background #121416, warm soft champagne rim light, consistent photorealistic 3D educational illustration, realistic light loads. Setup: Túmbate boca arriba con las rodillas dobladas, pies a la anchura de la cadera y brazos a los lados. Sequence technique: Aprieta los glúteos y eleva la cadera empujando con los talones. Sube hasta alinear hombros, cadera y rodillas. Mantén un segundo y baja vértebra a vértebra. Show EXACT named variant and equipment, not a substitute movement. Do not merge multiple athletes in a movement panel. No arrows inside frames. Bottom-right panel contains two faceless medical teaching mannequins front and back in opaque gray sports suits with colored muscle overlays, with accurately bounded colored muscles, no glow, no heatmap. Primary gluteus maximus pale champagne on BACK buttocks; hamstrings secondary amber for thrust/bridge/kickback. For hip abduction highlight gluteus medius and minimus at outer upper hip as PRIMARY rather than entire buttock. For step up quadriceps secondary amber. Primary color #D8C3A5; secondary #A77B47; unworked skin/muscles gray. Other figures and diagrams must not intrude in movement panels. Four assets will be cropped into independent rectangular images. Keep composition centered with 5% breathing room within EACH quadrant. Avoid decorative text, incorrect cable attachment, floating handles, disconnected weights. Instructional visual draft, not diagnosis.
